basis: native_schedule_bind invokes _native_complete_allocation before appending the schedule-binding record.

_native_complete_allocation invokes launch_allocation, which verifies the exact independent cases inventory, runtime coverage, cap of 24, preparation-call accounting, campaign duration, and per-attempt duration.
The binding record requires allocation/runtime snapshots, reconstructs schedule_allocation from the snapshot, and native_schedule_reserve rejects a schedule without that state.
Normal replay validates current gate bytes including allocation/runtime inputs; cleanup replay uses frozen snapshots and preserves the original schedule origin.
native_process_launch rechecks the current complete allocation and requires its allocation digest to equal the bound allocation digest.
